title: Prints are a bit fuzzy.
text:
Prints are a bit fuzzy.. Decent prints that hang well. We use Command strips to hang these and they stay on fine. There doesn't seem to be any warping or other uneven framing.

The prints themselves aren't sharp, however. I can notice pixelation on the edges of text.
